text.p: The Milwaukee Brewers lost their spark plug for at least two months when second baseman and leadoff hitter Fernando Vina suffered a fractured left ankle on Saturday.

Vina, who was coming off a career-best five RBI -- including his first career grand slam -- in Friday night's 10-3 victory at Cleveland, broke the ankle Saturday while stealing second base in the first inning of an 11-6 loss to the Indians.
His ankle hit the bag wrong and Vina was taken to hospital where X-rays revealed the broken ankle.
When asked how long Vina would be sidelined, Brewers manager Phil Garner said, "a couple of months, I'm sure."
